# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph rendering hardening**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp 4.156.2 update improves mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads disagree.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts** — Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph's path rather than a stale outline. Incompatible mask formats are rejected before copying, avoiding sub-byte buffer overwrites, while clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides to prevent corrupted or uncleared mask planes. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
